name: Vannix
description: Vannix was a planet located within the Vankalay system of the Core Worlds, in a sector bordering the Kuat sector. It was represented in the New Republic Senate by Addath Gadan until she advocated appeasing the Yuuzhan Vong during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
lead_paragraphs: Vannix was a planet located within the Vankalay system of the Core Worlds, in a sector bordering the Kuat sector. It was represented in the New Republic Senate by Addath Gadan until she advocated appeasing the Yuuzhan Vong during the Yuuzhan Vong War.
